label: Diagram 10.1
caption: Diagram 10.1 | Visibility requirements of doors Hazards on access routes
description:
"See para 10.1" appears top left. The drawing, captioned "Diagram 10.1 Visibility requirements of doors", shows two schematic views of a door leaf set within a wider rectangular frame, each with a small floor-level datum symbol at the bottom. A central label, "Minimum zones of visibility", has four arrows pointing to hatched (diagonally shaded) rectangular zones on the door leaves.

In the left view, two hatched zones are stacked vertically, one upper and one lower, with a handle symbol on the right edge beside the upper zone. A dimension on the left reads 1500mm from the datum to the top of the upper zone, and 500mm from the datum to the bottom of the lower zone.

In the right view, the upper hatched zone lies between 1150mm and 1500mm, and the lower hatched zone between 500mm and 800mm, with a handle symbol between them. Dimensions on the right read 1500mm, 1150mm, 800mm and 500mm above the datum. The hatched zones are the minimum visibility areas; the rest of the leaf is shown as a clear outline.
